name: handoff
description: /handoff writes a short handoff note for a Jira ticket from Jira, your Claude Code and Codex sessions, git and this conversation.

dir.title: Folder
dir.description: Where notes are saved, relative to the project root.

copy.title: Copy to clipboard
copy.description: Put each new note on the clipboard.

sessionDirs.title: Session folders
sessionDirs.description: Comma-separated Claude Code projects and Codex sessions folders searched for sessions on the ticket (~ is your home). Empty leaves sessions out.

sessionDays.title: Session days
sessionDays.description: How many days back a session on the ticket may have last been active.
